title: 1997 yil: Microsoft Apple'ga 150 million dollar kiritdi

scenes.text: 1997 yil avgustida Microsoft Apple'ga 150 million dollar kiritdi.
scenes.keywords: two rival businessmen shaking hands conference

scenes.text: Apple o'sha moliya yilida taxminan 1 milliard dollar zarar ko'rgan edi.
scenes.keywords: falling stock chart red screen office

scenes.text: Stiv Jobs buni e'lon qilganda zalning bir qismi hushtak chalgan.
scenes.keywords: audience reacting at tech conference stage

scenes.text: Kelishuv Apple'ga pul va besh yillik Office kafolatini berdi.
scenes.keywords: designer sketching new product at desk

scenes.text: 2018 yilda Apple qiymati 1 trillion dollarga yetgan birinchi AQSh kompaniyasi bo'ldi.

description: 1997 yil avgustida Microsoft Apple'ning ovoz huquqisiz aksiyalariga 150 million dollar kiritdi va Mac uchun Office dasturini kamida besh yil chiqarishga va'da berdi. Apple 1997 moliya yilida taxminan 1 milliard dollar sof zarar ko'rgan edi; 2018 yilda esa qiymati 1 trillion dollarga yetgan birinchi AQSh kompaniyasi bo'ldi. Siz raqibingiz bilan hamkorlik qila olasizmi?
source: Apple fiscal 1997 Q4 results (net loss $1.0 billion, year ended 26 Sept 1997), https://www.mactech.com/1997/10/15/md1-apple-reports-fourth-fiscal-quarter-results/ ; Engadget, What ever became of Microsoft's $150 million investment in Apple (150,000 Series A nonvoting preferred shares at $1,000), https://www.engadget.com/2014-05-20-what-ever-became-of-microsofts-150-million-investment-in-apple.html ; Neowin, Microsoft invested $150 million in Apple (6 August 1997, Macworld Boston, Office for Mac for five years), https://www.neowin.net/news/a-quick-look-back-at-when-microsoft-invested-150-million-in-apple-46-years-ago-today/ ; Time magazine, crowd booed (Gates' video image), https://content.time.com/time/magazine/article/0,9171,986850,00.html ; Cult of Mac, Microsoft investment saves Apple (fans booed the news), https://www.cultofmac.com/apple-history/microsoft-investment-saves-apple ; Bloomberg, Apple becomes first U.S. company to hit $1 trillion value (2 August 2018), https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-08-02/apple-share-gains-push-company-to-1-trillion-milestone
